bowman-sum.note: Embed-and-pool baseline: Bowman et al. (2015) 100d sum of words over GloVe 300d; trainable vs frozen embeddings.

bowman-lstm.note: Recurrent encoder: Bowman et al. (2015) 100d LSTM over GloVe 300d; trainable vs frozen embeddings.

bowman-gru.note: E1.1 GRU encoder: Bowman et al. (2015) setup with a 100d GRU (last hidden state) in place of the LSTM, over GloVe 300d; trainable vs frozen embeddings.

bowman-mean.note: E0.1 embed-and-pool pooling ablation: mean of projected GloVe 300d word vectors (vs bowman-sum); trainable vs frozen.

bowman-max.note: E0.1 embed-and-pool pooling ablation: max over projected GloVe 300d word vectors (vs bowman-sum); trainable vs frozen.

bowman-bert.note: Frozen bert-base-uncased mean-pooled sentence vectors (premise and hypothesis encoded separately) -> Bowman head: shared 768->100 tanh projection, combiner, 3x200 tanh MLP, AdaDelta. Combiner [u,v] vs [u,v,|u-v|,u*v] vs hypothesis-only.

bowman-max-hyp-only.note: E1.5 artifact baseline for the GloVe models: Bowman max pool (trainable GloVe 300d) on the hypothesis alone; the premise is never encoded. Compare with the concat run of the same encoder.

bowman-lstm-hyp-only.note: E1.5 artifact baseline for the GloVe models: Bowman LSTM (trainable GloVe 300d) on the hypothesis alone; the premise is never encoded. Compare with the concat run of the same encoder.
